name: Bangladeshi Payment Gateway for Quick Orders
author: Md Abul Bashar

sections.description:
Bangladeshi Payment Gateway for Quick Orders enables seamless integration of the bKash payment gateway with the Quick Orders plugin, providing a convenient payment option for Bangladeshi users. By adding bKash as a payment method, this plugin allows businesses to accept payments through one of the most popular mobile financial services in Bangladesh, simplifying transactions for both merchants and customers.

Key Features

  • bKash Payment Integration: Adds bKash as a payment option in the Quick Orders checkout process.
  • Admin Customization Options: Customize the payment label, description, gateway charge, and additional info from the WordPress admin.
  • Gateway Charges: Easily apply a gateway fee for bKash transactions, visible to customers at checkout.
  • bKash Phone Number Display: Option to display a dedicated bKash phone number for easier transactions.
  • Translation Ready: Fully localized and ready for translation to ensure compatibility with other languages.

Requirements

This plugin requires the Quick Orders plugin to be installed and active for full functionality. The Quick Orders plugin can be downloaded from the WordPress Plugin Directory.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bd-payment-for-quick-orders directory or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure that the Quick Orders plugin is active, as this plugin depends on it.
  4. Go to Settings > Quick Orders > Payment Methods to configure the bKash payment settings.
  5. Set the bKash payment label, description, gateway charge, and bKash phone number, and save changes.
  6. The bKash payment method will now be available for customers during checkout.
sections.faq:
Do I need the Quick Orders plugin for this to work?

Yes, the Quick Orders plugin must be installed and activated, as this plugin extends its functionality.

Can I set a gateway charge for bKash transactions?

Yes, you can set a custom gateway charge that will be displayed to customers at checkout.

How do I change the bKash payment label or description?

You can configure the bKash payment label, description, and additional info from the settings page in the WordPress admin under Quick Orders > Payment Methods.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is ready for translation and includes localization support.
